description: This file contains unit tests for the ViewPopup class within the SuiteCRM application, verifying its construction, behavior, and related file handling functions.

classes.name: ViewPopupTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ViewPopup class functionality in the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: testViewPopup
methods.description: Tests the constructor of the ViewPopup class and confirms its inheritance from SugarView and its 'type' property.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method of ViewPopup, particularly its handling of BeanFactory and session data.

methods.name: testdisplayGetModulePopupPickerIfNoListviewsSearchDefs
methods.description: Verifies get_custom_file_if_exists behavior when no custom popup picker exists and when it is created.

methods.name: testdisplayGetCustomDefaultPopupPickerIdNoModulePopupPicker
methods.description: Checks fallback behavior of get_custom_file_if_exists for default popup pickers, including handling when custom files are added.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, initializing user session and configuration.
